entities.summary: Fatma Aydemir is a German author and journalist based in Berlin. She is best known for her novel Ellbogen (Elbow), which won both the 2018 Franz Hessel Prize and the Klaus Michael Kühne prize for best debut novel of 2017. Fatma Aydemir was a journalists & chroniclers from Karlsruhe (b. 1986, Karlsruhe). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
